info.name: Shipzy Backend API (Docs Synced)
info.description:
Synced with backend/docs/api/*.md (system, auth, users, drivers, orders, addresses, static, business, ratings, admin).

Set collection variables before protected requests:
- accessToken - client/courier email or Google flows; ratings; orders (non-courier actions); addresses
- courierAccessToken - /drivers/* and courier-only /orders/*
- businessAccessToken - /business/*
- adminAccessToken - /admin/*
- courierUserId - numeric users.profiles.user_id for POST /admin/drivers/:userId/onboarding-review

Each API route uses {{baseUrl}}/api/v1/... (no nested variables).
